name: LLM provider failover
description: OpenTelemetry log alert: fires when llm.provider.failover is written
condition: count of structured logs WHERE event_type = 'llm.provider.failover' in last 5m > 0
message: LLM provider circuit opened. Check audit_log for failover details. Ops: verify OpenAI API health.
auto_resolve: yes — resolves when llm.provider.recovered is emitted
